# MarketCentaur

> MarketCentaur delivers AI-led transformation for every business, serving businesses of any size worldwide. It pairs human strategy with machine speed, combining AI-speed research with human review to fix common growth problems (websites that don't convert, B2B sales teams targeting the wrong accounts, repetitive work that should be automated) and runs done-for-you AI services: AI search visibility (GEO), AI front desks, AI content and video production, localization and AI training.

## Core packages
- [Website Conversion Sprint](https://marketcentaur.com/services#conversion-sprint): Five-pillar conversion audit, top-10 fix list, rewritten headline and CTA copy, and an AI search visibility check (ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity). First findings in 48 hours; full report in 3–5 business days.
- [B2B Account Intelligence Sprint](https://marketcentaur.com/services#account-sprint): ICP definition, ranked target-account list with sources, buying-role map, buying signals, competitor snapshot and outreach angles. Delivered in 5 business days.
- [AI Workflow Automation Sprint](https://marketcentaur.com/services#automation-sprint): Workflow mapping, ranked automation shortlist, pilot design with human approval steps, SOPs and an AI-use register. Delivered in 5–7 business days.
- [Growth Intelligence Retainer](https://marketcentaur.com/services#retainer): Ongoing signal watch, competitor tracking, performance briefs and fractional AI advice, billed monthly.

## Done-for-you AI services
- [AI Search Visibility (GEO)](https://marketcentaur.com/services/ai-search-visibility): Audits and ongoing optimization of how ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, Claude, Copilot and Google AI Overviews describe and recommend a business. Up to 25 buyer questions, competitor share-of-voice, gap analysis and a prioritized fix list; monthly re-testing for managed GEO.
- [AI Front Desk](https://marketcentaur.com/services/ai-front-desk): AI receptionist for phone calls plus WhatsApp and website chat assistants that answer FAQs, book appointments, capture leads and hand off to staff. Set up, tested and managed monthly.
- [AI Content & Video Studio](https://marketcentaur.com/services/ai-content-studio): Monthly AI-assisted production of short-form and explainer videos, social posts, blogs, newsletters and sales collateral, human-reviewed; white-label option for agencies.
- [AI Localization & Translation](https://marketcentaur.com/services/ai-localization): Websites, sales collateral, courses, product documents, subtitles and AI voiceover in new languages, with glossaries and human review.
- [AI Training & Workshops](https://marketcentaur.com/services/ai-training): Practical generative AI workshops for leaders, marketing, sales, operations and support teams, with prompt libraries and AI-use policies.

See https://marketcentaur.com/services#catalog

## Free tools
- [AI Visibility Check](https://marketcentaur.com/ai-visibility-check): Free 5-minute self-assessment of whether ChatGPT, Perplexity and Google AI mention and accurately describe a business, with a score and next steps.
- [Free website audit](https://marketcentaur.com/#free-audit): Short action brief with the three biggest conversion fixes, emailed within one business day.
- [Growth checks](https://marketcentaur.com/growth-check): 2-minute self-assessments for local businesses, ecommerce stores and traditional businesses.
- [Website inquiry readiness check](https://marketcentaur.com/website-enquiry-readiness)
- [Free growth toolkit](https://marketcentaur.com/toolkit): Six templates from client work: competitor signal tracker, account fit scorecard, automation candidate scorecard, website conversion checklist, AI visibility question set and scoping call question list.
- [Automation payback calculator](https://marketcentaur.com/automation-payback-calculator): Free in-browser estimate of the hours and cost a workflow automation could save each year, and its payback period.
- [Briefings](https://marketcentaur.com/briefings): Free monthly sector email with five sourced market signals, what they mean and one action. Sectors include B2B SaaS, construction, renewable energy, manufacturing and healthcare.

## Contact
- Email: hello@marketcentaur.com

## How we work
Scope, deliverables, timeline and price are agreed in writing before work starts. A person reviews all AI-assisted work, and every important finding links to its source. Pricing is a fixed quote after a free 20-minute scoping call. Outcomes such as leads or rankings are not guaranteed; deliverables and timelines are.

MarketCentaur offers 121 services across 17 practices. Every engagement is scoped and quoted on request; prices are not published.
- [All practices and bundles](https://marketcentaur.com/practices/)

Services: AI Readiness Scan; AI Opportunity Workshop; AI Transformation Roadmap; AI Business Case & ROI Model; Fractional AI Officer.
- [Automation & AI Agents](https://marketcentaur.com/practices/automation-ai-agents): Reduce repetitive work with dependable automations and carefully governed AI agents. Services: Automation Opportunity Audit; Workflow Automation Sprint; AI Agent Prototype; Custom AI Agent Build; Multi-agent Workflows; Automation Care; Agent Hosting & Tuning; Agent Rules Kit & Workshop.
- [Customer Experience & Conversational AI](https://marketcentaur.com/practices/conversational-ai): Make customer conversations more helpful across calls, chat, WhatsApp and service journeys. Services: Customer Experience Review; Website Chat Assistant; AI Voice Front Desk (calls, booking, WhatsApp); Customer Support Automation; Review & Reputation Monitoring; Managed Assistant.
- [Marketing, Content & Video](https://marketcentaur.com/practices/marketing-content-video): Build a consistent content programme that gives your expertise a clear, useful voice. Services: Content Strategy & 30-day Calendar; Brand Video Pack; Explainer & Ad Set; Podcast & Webinar Repurposing; Content Engine; Video Studio; Email & Newsletter Programs; AI Short-form Ad Pack (creator style).

Services: AI Search Visibility Audit (SEO + GEO); Paid Media Plan; Website Conversion Sprint; Analytics & Tracking Setup; Growth Engine Launch; Ecommerce Growth Sprint; Marketplace Listings Setup (Amazon, Etsy and others); AI Search Starter; Conversion Optimisation; Email & Retention Flows; Paid Media Management; ChatGPT Business Profile & Product Feed Setup; Local-Language AI Visibility Audit; AI Shopping Accuracy Monitor.

Services: Event Strategy & Calendar; Webinar & Virtual Event Production; Trade Show & Field Event Kit; Event Lead Follow-up Automation; Partner & Channel Program Management.

Services: Competitor Snapshot; Account & Persona Map; Supplier & Partner Scan; Industry Landscape Report; M&A and Partner Target Screening; Signal Watch; Competitor Offer Monitor; Deal-flow Watch; Sector Tracker; Tariff & Trade Exposure Brief.

Services: Document Workflow Review; Company Knowledge Assistant; Document Processing Pipeline (invoices, contracts, forms); Process & SOP Sprint; Localization (documents, websites, courses); Knowledge Upkeep.

## Insights
- [Insights hub](https://marketcentaur.com/insights/): Practical guides on competitive intelligence, B2B growth, AI and automation.
- [Your Business Now Has a Profile in ChatGPT. Is It Right?](https://marketcentaur.com/insights/chatgpt-business-profiles-what-to-check): OpenAI now lets businesses claim a ChatGPT profile, add product feeds and launch an agent. What changed, what to check first and how to measure it.
- [Where Should a Small Business Start with AI? A 30-Day Plan](https://marketcentaur.com/insights/where-to-start-with-ai-small-business): A practical 30-day plan for starting with AI in a small or mid-sized business: pick one problem, set ground rules, run a small pilot and measure it.
- [12 Competitor Signals Worth Tracking (and 5 to Ignore)](https://marketcentaur.com/insights/competitor-signals-worth-tracking): Which public competitor signals actually predict a change in strategy, which ones are mostly noise, and how to tell the difference.
- [How to Run Competitive Intelligence Without an Analyst Team](https://marketcentaur.com/insights/competitive-intelligence-without-an-analyst-team): A lightweight, weekly competitor-tracking system a one-person marketing team can set up in an afternoon, and how to turn what you collect into decisions.
